data.method: Twelve-second silent encoded study, frame coverage scan, HyperFrames lint/runtime/layout check, two agent contact-sheet interpretations and root encoded/browser inspection.
data.scope: Intended causal-staging diagnostic. The local test was successfully rendered; the owner intervention and resulting blocked work were not clearly established.
data.limitations: Agent contact-sheet review at2fps is not human audience or full-motion comprehension testing. The second read had roles supplied. Strict technical check has one intentional neck-pivot warning. No owner acceptance of this test output; no full rebuild or new avatar.

evidence.locator: Technical and creative results kept separate
First pass with no role context
Revised pass with owner and employee roles supplied

context.narrative_job: Deliver a thoughtful viewer-directed question with natural visible hand activity.
context.viewer_before: R39 question avatar holds quiet resting hands; the owner requires hand movement when rebuilt.
context.viewer_after: A conversational gesture supports the question and settles, without exaggerated or repetitive movement.

data.choice: Retain visible hand movement as a requirement for the next question-avatar rebuild. Proposed performance: one palm opens with What happens here, expands modestly through the thought and returns on month; settle through That is not small talk.
data.reason: R39 explicitly requested quiet hands. Wide framing and a gesture reference do not guarantee actual hand activity when the prompt suppresses it.

alternatives.choice: Reuse quiet R39 take without a performance update
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would not satisfy the owner hand-movement requirement.

alternatives.choice: Constant gestures or a new gesture on each phrase
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would recreate the rejected repetitive or exaggerated delivery.

reuse.applies_when: A presenter rebuild needs visible gestures that support the meaning and remain in frame.
reuse.avoid_when: Movement conflicts with the passage or owner direction; do not reuse fixed choreography across every question.

nuance.performance: Owner requirement is firm; the palm-up choreography is a proposed implementation and no new take exists. Preserve V5 identity, complete hands, near-lens eyeline, thoughtful face and exact current narration.
nuance.trigger: Next rebuild of the question avatar.
nuance.source_basis: Current owner instruction and R39 prompt/performance review; scoped proposal prepared without new paid calls.
nuance.false_inference: A recorded requirement is neither an accepted performance nor a new paid-generation receipt.
